NBA 10 - The Inside.name: NBA 10: The Inside
NBA 10 - The Inside.summary: The follow-up to NBA 09 The Inside, this basketball sim is made by Sony and is exclusive to their platforms.

Pipe Mania.name: Pipe Mania
Pipe Mania.summary: Pipe Mania is a puzzle game where players must place random tiles in order to help water flow to its destiny.

Tanteibu - The Detective Club - Angou to.name: Tanteibu: The Detective Club - Angou to Misshitsu to Kaijin to
Tanteibu - The Detective Club - Angou to.summary: Second in the four volume romantic detective story. The detective team consists of Maya, Tora and Natsu, three teenage girls and Sodom, a little robot with a useful set of skills. Each game in the series focuses on three different cases you have to solve.
